entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The conflict between New Phyrexia's Machine Legion and the Multiverse at large, ending with the Multiversal coalition's victory, the deaths of the Praetors and the phasing-out of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Machine Legion
entities.description: New Phyrexia's invasion force, an evolution of Elesh Norn's Machine Orthodoxy, split into five hosts.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Mirrodin after its conquest and transformation; the Phyrexian homeworld that launches the invasion and is later phased out.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The White-aligned Phyrexian praetor who became sole power above New Phyrexia and masterminded the invasion of the Multiverse.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: The blue-aligned praetor who deferred to Norn, sought a way to compleat planeswalkers and commanded the Chrome Host.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who invaded Kaldheim, commanded the Copper Host and was slain in the battle for New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A praetor who planned rebellion against Norn and led the invasion of Dominaria before her execution.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A praetor who planned rebellion, conspired with Tezzeret, helped the Mirran Resistance and refused to take part in the invasion.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker whose Planar Bridge served Norn in return for a promised darksteel body; he conspired with Urabrask and eventually obtained the body.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A planeswalker who opposed Vorinclex on Kaldheim, joined the strike force and killed the compleated Heliod.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: A god of Kaldheim who helped confront Vorinclex.

entities.name: Esika
entities.description: A god of Kaldheim wounded by Vorinclex.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker and the first captured and compleated by Jin-Gitaxias; she corrupted Boseiju and was killed by the Wanderer.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker tasked by Urabrask to find Elspeth who later helped defend Ikoria and finished off Lukka.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker and experienced commander who led the strike force, took the Sylex and became an archangel.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A being who discovered Sheoldred on Dominaria, was trapped by her and captured by the compleated Ajani.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker captured and unknowingly compleated as a sleeper agent, later cleansed of phyresis.

entities.name: Phyrexian Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: The compleated version of Ajani who revealed his Phyrexian nature on Dominaria and led the first wave on Theros.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A Dominarian killed by the compleated Ajani.

entities.name: Teferi Akosa
entities.description: A character who helped create the Temporal Anchor, was thrown through time to Zhalfir and led the counter-invasion of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped Teferi create the Temporal Anchor, made a copy of the Sylex and warned Kaladesh.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who organized the strike force against New Phyrexia and was compleated by Vraska.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker and Jace's lover, compleated in Sheoldred's Coliseum, who led the invasion of Ravnica.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker in the strike force who later faced Tamiyo on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker in the strike force who was injured, captured and compleated, then later cleansed.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A planeswalker in the strike force who fused with the beast Rothga, was compleated and later killed on Ikoria.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who began compleating after being scratched, dropped the Coliseum and led the invasion of Zendikar.

entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: A planeswalker in the strike force who later fought on New Phyrexia and escaped to Zhalfir.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: A planeswalker in the strike force who fought a compleated serpent on Kaldheim.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A planeswalker in the strike force whose spark was disrupted; she appeared to kill Tamiyo on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A Mirran who brought the strike force to Lowlight and whose sacrifice helped cleanse Ajani and Nissa.

entities.name: Thrun
entities.description: A Mirran who brought Elspeth and Kaya below and escaped to Zhalfir.

entities.name: Rothga
entities.description: A Phyrexian beast of the Hunter Maze with which Lukka bonded and fused.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: A Phyrexian who fought alongside Vorinclex against Nissa and Lukka in the Hunter Maze.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: Norn's lieutenant who led the invasion of Capenna and was killed when Park Heights fell on her.

entities.name: Rona
entities.description: A newly compleated character tasked with invading Dominaria.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A character who bonded with Realmbreaker and switched New Phyrexia and Zhalfir in the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who warned Kaladesh and went with Wrenn to New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who repelled the invasion of Ravnica and defeated Vraska with a sonic weapon.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: Amonkhet's protector god who ignited the glistening oil in Phyrexians' veins.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: Hazoret's loyal lieutenant who led elite fighters against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: A Strixhaven student who vanished after his planeswalker's spark ignited while casting the Invocation.

entities.name: Rankle
entities.description: A fae who defeated the Eldraine invasion with a love potion.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A Theros god who was compleated and then killed by Kaya Cassir.

entities.name: Etali
entities.description: An elder dinosaur of Ixalan, compleated and then felled by Zacama.

entities.name: Zacama
entities.description: A dinosaur god of Ixalan who felled Etali.

entities.name: Vadrok
entities.description: A monster of Ikoria who ripped Lukka from his flesh-titan.

entities.name: Jirina Kudro
entities.description: A survivor of Drannith who led refugees to Vadrok's nest.

entities.name: Fynn
entities.description: A character of Kaldheim and nemesis of the Cosmos Serpent.

entities.name: Koma
entities.description: The Cosmos Serpent of Kaldheim, compleated and later killed.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: Tamiyo's adoptive son who faced her with Kaito.

entities.name: Alabaster Host
entities.description: The fanatical bulk of the Machine Legion, led by Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Chrome Host
entities.description: A Machine Legion host commanded by Jin-Gitaxias that gathered information.

entities.name: Etched Host
entities.description: The brutal host divided among the Steel Thanes.

entities.name: Furnace Host
entities.description: A host with no leader, turned loose by Norn after Urabrask refused to participate.

entities.name: Copper Host
entities.description: A host commanded by Vorinclex that compleated only the strongest.

entities.name: Mirran Resistance
entities.description: The resistance on New Phyrexia that opposed Norn.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: The artifact the strike force meant to detonate; destroyed by the compleated Ajani, with its replica lost in the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: New Phyrexia's version of a World Tree, created from tyrite, that broke through to many planes.

entities.name: Temporal Anchor
entities.description: A device that allowed Teferi's spirit to travel through time; it malfunctioned.

entities.name: Luxior
entities.description: The weapon with which Elspeth stabbed Jace.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: Tezzeret's device that let Norn send her agents across the Multiverse.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: An angelic substance highly toxic to Phyrexians that halts or repels compleation.

entities.name: Compleation
entities.description: The Phyrexian process of converting beings, removing a victim's soul and spark.

entities.name: Glistening oil
entities.description: The Phyrexian oil that infects minds and compleates victims.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Paths that appeared across the Multiverse from Realmbreaker's scars, letting non-planeswalkers travel between planes.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes where the Sylex exploded and where the planes were switched.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: A plane first invaded by Vorinclex; its World Tree was burned.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: A plane where the invasion began at Towashi and Tamiyo was killed.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane invaded by Sheoldred and later Rona.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: The time-distorted plane that replaced New Phyrexia and where Teferi organized the counter-invasion.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane whose invasion Vraska led.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane whose gods were largely compleated.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: A plane devastated by the compleated Lukka.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A plane invaded by three hosts from the seas.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: A plane whose courts fell before the invasion was defeated by Rankle's trick.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane of Strixhaven, where the Invocation of the Founders thwarted the invasion.

entities.name: Capenna
entities.description: The plane of the Halo source; the city of New Capenna resisted Atraxa.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane whose invasion was led by phyrexianized Nahiri.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane where Hazoret and the survivors struck back at the Copper Host.

entities.name: Seedcore
entities.description: The place on New Phyrexia where Realmbreaker grew and Norn oversaw the invasion.

entities.name: Invocation of the Founders
entities.description: The spell cast at Strixhaven that temporarily thwarted the invasion.

entities.name: Operation Falling Star
entities.description: The Capennan resistance action that dropped Park Heights on Atraxa.

events.summary: After conquering Mirrodin, Elesh Norn starts a civil war against the other praetors and emerges as sole power above New Phyrexia, evolving the Machine Orthodoxy into the Machine Legion.
events.quote: Emerging as the Mother of Machines and sole power above all of New Phyrexia

events.summary: Elesh Norn promises Tezzeret a darksteel body for the use of his Planar Bridge.
events.quote: After promising Tezzeret a darksteel body in exchange for his help

events.summary: Vorinclex invades Kaldheim and is confronted by Kaya, Alrund and the Omenseekers; he wounds Esika and leaves with a tyrite sample.
events.quote: he fought and wounded the god Esika before leaving Kaldheim with a sample of tyrite

events.summary: Norn uses the tyrite to create Realmbreaker, New Phyrexia's World Tree.
events.quote: Elesh Norn used the Tyrite sample to create New Phyrexia's version of a World Tree, the Realmbreaker

events.summary: Tamiyo becomes the first planeswalker captured and compleated by Jin-Gitaxias's experiments.
events.quote: Tamiyo would be the first planeswalker captured and subjected to the process of compleation

events.summary: Urabrask conspires with Tezzeret against Norn, goes to New Capenna, obtains Halo and tasks Vivien Reid with finding Elspeth.
events.quote: Urabrask conspired with Tezzeret

events.summary: Sheoldred invades Dominaria with sleeper agents; Karn discovers her but is trapped in a cave-in.
events.quote: she was able to trap him in a cave-in

events.summary: Ajani is captured and unknowingly compleated as a sleeper agent.
events.quote: he was captured and unknowingly compleated as a sleeper agent

events.summary: The compleated Ajani reveals his Phyrexian nature, kills Jaya Ballard, captures Karn and destroys the Sylex.
events.quote: revealed his new Phyrexian nature, killed Jaya Ballard

events.summary: Teferi and Saheeli create the Temporal Anchor to send Teferi's spirit back in time.
events.quote: Teferi Akosa and Saheeli Rai created an artifact called the Temporal Anchor

events.summary: Teferi witnesses the Sylex Blast and learns a person is needed to activate the Sylex.
events.quote: found out that it was a person, not a spell or an artifact, that could activate the Sylex

events.summary: The Temporal Anchor malfunctions and Teferi is flung to Zhalfir.
events.quote: he had ended up on Zhalfir

events.summary: Jace warns planeswalkers and assembles a strike force, naming Elspeth leader, to detonate the Sylex in the Seedcore.
events.quote: He named Elspeth the leader of the group

events.summary: The strike force infiltrates New Phyrexia, but Norn's planar shield scatters them; Nahiri is scratched and begins compleating.
events.quote: Nahiri was scratched by a Phyrexian during the initial fight, beginning her compleation

events.summary: In the Hunter Maze Lukka fuses with Rothga and is fully compleated after fighting Vorinclex and Glissa.
events.quote: Lukka fusing with Rothga, fully compleating him

events.summary: Nissa is captured and compleated.
events.quote: Nissa would later be captured and compleated as well

events.summary: Vraska, fighting in Sheoldred's Coliseum, is too far gone to be saved and infects Jace.
events.quote: she was already too far gone, and she infected Jace as well

events.summary: Nahiri drops the Coliseum into the Fair Basilica, bringing the strike force closer to the Seedcore.
events.quote: Nahiri dropped the Coliseum into the Fair Basilica

events.summary: Jace tries to detonate the Sylex and fights the incompleat planeswalkers; Elspeth stabs him with Luxior and takes the Sylex.
events.quote: Elspeth stabbed Jace with Luxior and picked up the Sylex

events.summary: The Sylex explodes as Elspeth tries to planeswalk, sending both outside the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: it exploded, sending itself and Elspeth outside the Blind Eternities

events.summary: With the strike force's failure, Elesh Norn and the compleated planeswalkers begin the invasion and millions of Phyrexians pour through the omenpaths.
events.quote: Millions of Phyrexians immediately entered the omenpaths and traveled to new planes

events.summary: Tezzeret obtains his darksteel body but escapes to Esper before Jin-Gitaxias can compleat him.
events.quote: he did obtain his promised darksteel body at Jin-Gitaxias' hands but escaped to Esper

events.summary: Urabrask refuses to take part in the invasion, so the Furnace Host is unled.
events.quote: Urabrask refused to participate in the invasion

events.summary: Hazoret ignites the glistening oil in Phyrexians' veins on Amonkhet while Djeru's fighters dismember them.
events.quote: Hazoret used her flaming spear to ignite the glistening oil within the Phyrexians' veins

events.summary: The Invocation of the Founders temporarily thwarts the invasion of Arcavios.
events.quote: The Invocation of the Founders temporarily thwarted the invasion

events.summary: Quintorius Kand vanishes as his spark ignites from casting the Invocation.
events.quote: Quintorius Kand had vanished, his planeswalker's spark ignited by the stress of casting the Invocation

events.summary: Atraxa is dispatched to lead the invasion of Capenna and cut off Halo.
events.quote: Elesh Norn dispatched Atraxa as her lieutenant to lead the invasion

events.summary: In Operation Falling Star, the resistance drops Park Heights on Atraxa, killing her.
events.quote: destroyed Park Heights, dropping the entire neighborhood on Atraxa, killing her and turning the tide against the invaders

events.summary: Norn tasks the newly compleated Rona with invading Dominaria.
events.quote: Elesh Norn tasked the newly compleat Rona with the invasion of Dominaria

events.summary: Rankle's love potion makes the Phyrexian invaders chase him to their deaths, ending the Eldraine invasion.
events.quote: Rankle the fae used a Ring of Three Wishes to make a love potion rain down across Locthwain

events.summary: Lukka returns to Ikoria compleated and sacks Drannith.
events.quote: Lukka returned to Ikoria compleated

events.summary: Vadrok rips Lukka from his flesh-titan, and Lukka is burned and finished off by Vivien.
events.quote: Lukka was then burned by Vadrok's ethereal fire and finished off by Vivien

events.summary: Zacama fells the compleated dinosaur Etali on Ixalan.
events.quote: Etali was finally felled by Zacama after injuring Zetalpa

events.summary: On Kamigawa the Wanderer appears at the last moment and kills Tamiyo.
events.quote: At the last possible moment, the Wanderer appeared and killed Tamiyo

events.summary: Vraska leads the invasion of Ravnica.
events.quote: Vraska led the invasion of Ravnica

events.summary: Ral Zarek defeats Vraska with a sonic weapon and Jace's memory reset frees her of Phyrexian control.
events.quote: Vraska triggered Jace's memory reset

events.summary: A Phyrexian Ajani leads the first wave on Theros, targeting temples, and the gods are compleated.
events.quote: the first wave of the invasion targeted temples and other places of worship

events.summary: Kaya kills the distracted compleated Heliod after a Capennan counter-invasion of Theros.
events.quote: the compleated Heliod was distracted enough to be killed by Kaya Cassir

events.summary: Nahiri is foiled by Akiri's party on Zendikar after compleating elementals.
events.quote: but was foiled by Akiri and her party

events.summary: Wrenn bonds with Realmbreaker and contacts Teferi on Zhalfir, who leads a counter-invasion of New Phyrexia.
events.quote: she was able to contact Teferi Akosa on Zhalfir

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias, Vorinclex and Elesh Norn are slain, leaving Urabrask the only living praetor.
events.quote: Jin-Gitaxias, Vorinclex, and Elesh Norn were slain, leaving Urabrask as the only living praetor

events.summary: Wrenn manipulates Realmbreaker to swap New Phyrexia and Zhalfir in the Blind Eternities, ending the invasion.
events.quote: Wrenn manipulated Realmbreaker to switch the places of Zhalfir and New Phyrexia in the Blind Eternities

events.summary: Most planeswalkers lose their sparks in the aftermath.
events.quote: the vast majority of planeswalkers lost their sparks

events.summary: Ajani and Nissa are cleansed of phyresis.
events.quote: Ajani Goldmane and Nissa Revane were cleansed of phyresis

events.summary: Elspeth transforms into an archangel and gains immortality.
events.quote: Elspeth Tirel transformed into an archangel and gained immortality

relations.quote: The Alabaster Host was led directly by Elesh Norn

relations.note: He defeated her with a sonic weapon on Ravnica.
relations.quote: Zarek able to defeat Vraska with a sonic weapon attuned against the oil

relations.note: Killed the compleated Heliod on Theros.
relations.quote: the compleated Heliod was distracted enough to be killed by Kaya Cassir

relations.note: Killed the compleated Tamiyo on Kamigawa.
relations.quote: At the last possible moment, the Wanderer appeared and killed Tamiyo

relations.quote: Elesh Norn tasked the newly compleat Rona with the invasion of Dominaria

relations.quote: Elspeth stabbed Jace with Luxior and picked up the Sylex
